notes: Measured profile: service rates fitted to 40 real gfx1201 attention timings in measured-attention-r9700.json. In-sample median error 18.6%, worst 59.3%; half/half holdout median 21.9%. Clock/power uncontrolled; not a production guarantee. Rate provenance: Fit of the declared demand model to 40 real gfx1201 timings in measured-attention-r9700.json (median of 15 repetitions each). In-sample median error 18.6%, worst 59.3%; half/half holdout median 21.9%. Per-family overrides fitted to the same 40 timings: a kernel family reaches a different fraction of peak, so the device-wide rate cannot describe both. attn_decode in-sample median error 11.5% (max 25.0%), attn_prefill 26.2% (max 35.7%). Extrapolating to an unseen context length is NOT covered: with three measured depths the fit is underdetermined there. Analytic attention model under pinned clocks (sclk 1634 MHz, mclk 1258 MHz, set on the Proxmox host; 60 s warmup, min of 15): T = a + max(F, ctx*(s*(1+k*(b-1)) + sq*q*b)). In-sample error per family is recorded in the task report; this is a formula with measured constants, not a lookup table. Analytic attention model, form T = a + max(F, ctx*(s*(1+k*(b-1)) + sq*q*b)), fitted on the training part of the 168-point grid (ctx 2k-64k, q 1/2/4/8 decode and 16/32/64 prefill, b 1/2/4/8) under pinned clocks. Held-out corners: decode median 8.2%/8.1%, max 24.4%/20.7%; prefill median 1.5%/4.3%, max 5.7%/9.0%. The 5% max target is NOT met for decode; the residual is occupancy/bandwidth-concurrency, not a missing rate. Analytic attention model: T = a + max(F, s*ctx*b^ps, c*q*b*ctx) with a start cost, F scan floor, s KV scan per context token, ps the batch saturation exponent and c the per-query-work cost. Fitted on the training part of the 168-point grid; held-out corners (ctx=32768, b=8) give decode median 7.8/11.7 %, max 18.7/18.9 %; prefill median 1.7/5.6 %, max 5.4/8.9 %.
